SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, min(calendar_date) d0, max(calendar_date) d1, count(*) n
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT d.fiscal_year, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_ids, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) wh, (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d2.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND d2.fiscal_week=d.fiscal_week AND r.store_id NOT IN (999)) rpt_all,
 SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id=900 THEN n.net_sales END) web
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, count(DISTINCT r.store_id) stores, sum(r.net_sales) ns, sum(r.receipts) rec
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id<>999
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week IN (7,8)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, count(*) n_status, o.status, count(*) FROM fact_web_order o JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,4

SELECT 'ret' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d2, sum(CASE WHEN refund_net<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), 0, sum(CASE WHEN status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'webno_order', count(*), count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 0, 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL AND f.sale_date>=DATE '2025-05-26'
UNION ALL SELECT 'webstatus_lines', count(*), 0,0, sum(CASE WHEN o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE f.sale_date>=DATE '2025-05-26'
UNION ALL SELECT 'filtered_999_zz', count(*), 0, 0, sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test') AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2026-06-28'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ty.net_sales AS this_year_net_sales, ly.net_sales AS last_year_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
